title: Radio
summary: Listen with an RTL-SDR stick and decode what the air carries: rtl-sdr's tools, multimon-ng (POCSAG, AFSK, DTMF), Direwolf (APRS, packet).
consent: These tools receive only; rtl-sdr's rtl_tcp listens on the box for a client if you start it. Transmitting (Direwolf with a radio) is yours to license.
notes: rtl_test -t says whether the stick is seen; rtl_fm piped into multimon-ng decodes pagers and AFSK; Direwolf with a USB sound card and a radio is an APRS digipeater or iGate for the mesh's neighbours.
Meshtastic's own radios are reached through meshtasticd and the hub's Meshtastic page, not this kit.
